resources.string: Set the document width and height.
On: the tool rail docks on the left, out of a right hand\'s way. Off: it docks on the right.
Show ruler measurements in inches rather than centimetres.
On: the Frame tool\'s properties dock on the side of the canvas. Off: they stay in the bottom sheet.
Zooming in enlarges the brush on screen and zooming out shrinks it; the Size slider remains the base diameter.
When you lift your finger after drawing a surface, straighten lines, square up corners, make circles and mirrored shapes exact. Undo brings back your raw line.

Caps how often a stroke is redrawn. Every touch sample is always kept, and Brush never redraws faster than the screen refreshes, so Unlimited means once per displayed frame. A lower cap draws less power.

Resolution new layers are created at, as a share of the screen. Each layer holds a full-size image, so halving this quarters the memory a layer costs — lower it if the app runs out of memory with several layers open. Existing layers keep the resolution they were made at.
The licences of the libraries Graffux is built with.
Diagnostics and experimental options. You don\'t need these to paint.
Draws three test dabs with the GPU and shows the result. If this fails, the problem is this device\'s graphics driver.
Filing rankings as GitHub issues on HereLiesAz/Graffux.

Paste your own fine-grained GitHub token, limited to HereLiesAz/Graffux with Issues: read and write only. Reports are posted as public issues under your GitHub account. The token is stored encrypted on this device, never in backups; Disconnect forgets it.

Off by default, and only for people 16 or older. When enabled, Graffux records raw stroke input (touch path, pressure, contact size) and motion-sensor readings, plus your device model and screen size, but no names, location or image content. Finished sessions are uploaded to a private store used for training; they are not published. A stroke is a path of points, so leave this off while writing or signing something. Turn it off to stop collection and uploads. The Privacy Policy explains removal; it does not list a private contact for requests yet. %1$d file(s) currently waiting on this device. Applies next time the canvas opens.
Stroke contribution was switched off. Turn it on again in Settings to confirm you are 16 or older.

Contributing stroke data is only for people who are 16 or older. By continuing you confirm that you are. This is your own statement; Graffux does not check it. You can switch contribution off at any time.
Which predictors run while you draw. Pick one to test it alone; takes effect next time the canvas opens.
Standard, steadier (less overshoot, more lag) or more responsive (follows turns, overshoots more). Reports name the tuning so they can be compared.

Draws the stroke in progress straight to the screen from the GPU engine, skipping the app\'s own frame. Normal-blend layers with nothing visible above them; everything else draws as before. Takes effect next time the canvas opens.
Expect a soft red blob with two firmer, darker-edged lobes overlapping it — that\'s the hardness falloff and SRC_OVER build-up the stamp shader is responsible for.
Off by default. When on, Google Firebase Analytics records anonymous app usage events (screens opened, app version, device model, country). No drawings, names or location are included.

Off by default. When on, crashes and freezes after this point are posted as public GitHub issues on HereLiesAz/Graffux, under your own GitHub account and with your own token (set under About → Developer); anyone can read them, and you can delete your own issue on GitHub. The report holds the error, device model, Android and app version, and recent app log lines, with tokens, emails, file paths and coordinates removed. Without your token nothing is sent.
Detected tier: %1$s. The last calibration did not finish; the default is in use.
Tap to measure this GPU again in the background (a few seconds; drawing cancels it).

Each dab appears immediately as a quick draft, then refines automatically. GPU capability, thermal headroom and the remaining dab backlog determine how quickly full quality arrives. There is no drying timer. Applies to the next stroke.

Rooted devices only. Also records the touch controller\'s raw capacitive image around each stroke -- the real contact shape -- through a small read-only helper run with su. Turning it on asks for root now. Applies next time the canvas opens.
